policy.reason: Do not invent per-chapter triangle or texture-memory ceilings before measured target-device baselines exist.
policy.source_audit_role: Report source triangle equivalents, source bytes, texture dimensions and structural defects on every production-asset batch.

provisional_review_thresholds.note: Review threshold only; Unreal import compression/mips and actual residency decide runtime cost.

promotion_rule: Hard per-chapter limits may be enabled only after a reproducible target-device capture records scene identity, commit SHA, FPS/frame time and memory evidence.
